programs.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the fight against the international cocaine trade in the Caribbean.AMO agents and DHS investigators conduct intensive operations in Puerto Rico and neighboring islands, thwarting smuggling attempts.

programs.title: Tut's Treasures
programs.desc: British archaeologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamun's resting place in November 1922.The event became a real sensation due to the fact that it was the only pharaoh's tomb not plundered by thieves.More than 5,000 priceless items were found, including the famous golden mask, three beds and a throne.The most up-to-date findings about treasures hidden from the world for four thousand years will be presented.DNA tests conducted in museum laboratories revealed a dark secret hidden by the Egyptian ruler.

programs.title: Stalin - Trotsky: A Battle To Death
programs.desc: On August 20, 1940, on the orders of Joseph Stalin, Leon Trotsky was killed.Thanks to this move, the tyrant got rid of his most dangerous rival and secured absolute power for himself.The documentary presents an ideological struggle between different visions of communism, a political duel for power and a life-and-death fight between two completely different men.On the one hand, the son of a Georgian shoemaker, on the other, a member of the Jewish intelligentsia.The film shows the history of one of the most important rivalries of the 20th century, which strengthened dictatorial rule.

programs.title: Nazi Megastructures 6
programs.desc: Details of military solutions, tactics and technologies used by countries participating in World War II will be presented.The creators will reveal what the German anti-aircraft defense system looked like and will also talk about the Burma Death Railway.The 415 km long line was built by Japan.Its creation resulted in the death of thousands of people, mainly prisoners of war and civilians.Historians will also go on a journey around the Pacific islands, visiting places in Europe and Africa where fierce fighting took place.In the bunkers built on the territory of the Third Reich, you can still find remains of equipment and impressive fortifications.The enormous structures were intended to ensure that Hitler maintained control over the Old Continent.
